summary: Implemented ADR-028 clause 4 (G8) in src/ArrTags/Configuration/config.html exactly per the task 16.4 jellyfin-expert spike recommendation: a best-effort, fail-open modal reminder when a restart-required setting changes on save. The submit handler snapshots the persisted restart-required values from the freshly fetched configuration at the top of its ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(...) callback before any mutation (through the restartRequiredFields classification mirror), sets restartRequiredChanged when any classified value differs from the snapshot, and the existing ApiClient.updatePluginConfiguration(PluginConfig.pluginId, config) call now ends with .then(function (result) { Dashboard.processPluginConfigurationUpdateResult(result); showRestartRequiredReminder(restartRequiredChanged); }) so the unchanged SettingsSaved handler runs first and a rejected POST shows no reminder. showRestartRequiredReminder resolves window.Dashboard lazily, guards on !window.Dashboard || typeof window.Dashboard.alert !== 'function', wraps the call in a swallowing try/catch, and calls window.Dashboard.alert({ title: 'Jellyfin restart required', message: '<plain text>' }) (body under `message`, not `text`; no toast, confirm, dialogHelper, or showMessage). The task 16.3 note text is untouched and remains the authoritative fail-open behavior. Escape/backdrop dismissal is accepted as the shim's benign unhandled promise rejection and is documented. tests/ArrTags.Tests/RestartRequiredReminderTests.cs adds 5 classification-derived structural cases (the repository has no JavaScript runtime, so the modal cannot be executed). docs/architecture/06-configuration-and-persisted-state.md now describes the shipped best-effort reminder instead of 'decided but not yet implemented'; the changelog, docs/plan/state.json (16.5 done + report), and PLANS.md tick are updated. No classification, note text, save path, persisted state, validation semantics, endpoint, or dependency changed.

interpretations.question: How the computed 'restart-required value changed' flag reaches the reminder function (the spike's conditional logic fixes the snapshot/comparison but not the transport).
interpretations.chosen: Pass it as an explicit function argument: showRestartRequiredReminder(restartRequiredChanged), computed from the in-handler snapshot; a missing/falsy state returns without showing anything.
interpretations.basis: The spike's preferred in-handler snapshot logic; an argument avoids a page-global flag that could be stale across pageshow/submit cycles and makes the 'state is missing' fail-open case a plain falsy check. No user-visible or persisted semantics change.
interpretations.impact: None on user-visible behavior; structural test pins the single call site and its argument.

interpretations.question: Dismissed-modal behavior: the shim's Dashboard.alert(object) returns no promise and attaches no .catch, so Escape/backdrop dismissal rejects unhandled.
interpretations.chosen: Accept the benign unhandled promise rejection (the spike-permitted option) and document it; do not switch to Dashboard.confirm.
interpretations.basis: The task mandates Dashboard.alert and explicitly forbids Dashboard.confirm; the spike records the rejection as benign and offers acceptance as an option; it affects only the browser console, not the save or the page.
interpretations.impact: A console-only unhandled rejection when the operator dismisses without pressing 'Got it'. Documented in docs/architecture/06-configuration-and-persisted-state.md and the changelog.

interpretations.question: Exact modal title and message strings (the spike fixes the title example and leaves the message as '<plain-text explanation>').
interpretations.chosen: title 'Jellyfin restart required' (from the spike); message 'A restart-required setting changed. A Jellyfin server restart is required for the change to take effect; the note text next to the setting states whether some paths apply the change immediately.'
interpretations.basis: Matches ADR-028 clause 3/4 semantics (restart required; mixed settings may apply immediately) and stays plain text so the shim's DOMPurify-sanitized dialog renders it as a body, not markup.
interpretations.impact: User-visible modal wording only; no persisted state, save path, or classification change.

test_sensitivity: TheReminderFunctionFailsOpenWhenTheModalApiIsMissingOrFails: removing the availability guard block produced 1 failure; restoring it passed. Removing the try/catch produced 1 failure; restoring it passed. The test also fails if a bare Dashboard.alert reference or a window.Dashboard reference outside the reminder function is introduced.

TheReminderIsCalledOnlyFromTheSuccessfulUpdateCallbackAfterTheExistingResultHandler: swapping the reminder before Dashboard.processPluginConfigurationUpdateResult produced 1 failure (ordering assertion); restoring the order passed. The single-call-site and success-callback extraction assertions fail if the reminder is moved into the load path, duplicated, or removed.

TheReminderDetectionDomainIsTheCodeOwnedRestartRequiredSet: flipping a mirror mixed flag produced 1 failure; restoring it passed. It fails if the mirror drifts from RestartRequiredSettings.RestartRequired or if a second literal restart-required list is introduced.

TheChangeDetectionSnapshotsPersistedValuesBeforeMutationAndComparesBeforeSaving: replacing the snapshot read with a non-persisted value produced 1 failure; moving the snapshot after the first mutation produced 1 failure; restoring both passed. It fails if the snapshot stops reading config.Limits[...] through the mirror, if the comparison is removed or changed away from !==, or if the compare no longer precedes the update request.

TheReminderUsesThePlainTextSingleButtonAlertNotTheToastOrMissingApis: passing text: instead of message: produced 1 failure; restoring message: passed. It fails on the toast string form, Dashboard.showMessage, Dashboard.confirm, Dashboard.dialogHelper, an empty body, or a markup body.

The modal itself cannot be executed in this repository: there is deliberately no JavaScript runtime, so no test runs showRestartRequiredReminder or Dashboard.alert. The tests are structural assertions over the embedded page text, and no live-browser probe was performed (the task 16.4 spike confirmed the API against the pinned bundled asset and jellyfin-web v12.0 source only).

known_limitations: The modal behavior cannot be executed by the test suite: the repository deliberately has no JavaScript runtime, so the shipped verification is structural assertions over the embedded page plus the task 16.4 pinned-asset/source research; a live-browser confirmation of window.Dashboard/Dashboard.alert on the pinned web build was not performed (the pinned test host runs --nowebclient). This is a verification gap, not a functional claim.

Escape/backdrop dismissal of the modal produces a benign unhandled promise rejection in the jellyfin-web shim (Dashboard.alert(object) attaches no .catch); it affects only the browser console and not the save or the page, and it is documented in docs/architecture/06 and the changelog.

The modal is a best-effort web-only behavior on an intentionally retained, potentially unstable jellyfin-web compatibility shim; on any client or web build without window.Dashboard.alert the reminder shows nothing and the always-present task 16.3 note text remains the behavior (the ADR-028 clause 4 fail-open condition).
